author: reek
body: The same refusal on the OTHER builtin, whose lane count is four rather than two. `vec-extract` and `vec4-extract` carry different vectors in their types, so a check that hardcoded one count would pass one of these two files and fail the other.

author: reek
body: Lane 4 is the first illegal lane of a `Vector 4`. The last LEGAL one, lane 3, is read by codex/test/vector-f32.codex, which is the positive control that this bound is not off by one in the refusing direction.
